map.根据使用场景和患者年龄，计算简易呼吸器（球囊面罩）的通气频率、潮气量和挤压节奏，: Computes bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation rate, tidal volume and squeeze rhythm by scenario and patient age, with a metronome guide.
map.通气频率按场景与年龄取值：成人 10 至 12 次/分（CPR 高级气道建立后固: Rates by scenario and age: adult 10-12/min (fixed 10/min after an advanced airway, one every 6 s); child 12-20/min; infant 20-30/min; during CPR both child and infant 20-30/min (one every 2-3 s). Tidal volume about 6-7 mL/kg or 1/2-1/3 bag squeeze; squeeze:relax 1:1 to 1:2, each squeeze about 1 s. Bag size must match age: adult 1500 mL, child 800 mL, infant 240 mL; a mismatch is flagged in the result area.

map.球囊过大：婴儿应选婴儿型(240mL)，成人型(1500mL) 送气量难以控制，: Bag too large: choose the infant 240 mL bag for an infant; the 1500 mL adult bag makes delivered volume hard to control and risks hyperventilation and gastric distension.

map.球囊偏大：儿童建议选儿童型(800mL)，成人型(1500mL) 单次潮气量偏大: Bag slightly large: for a child prefer the 800 mL child bag; the 1500 mL adult bag delivers too much tidal volume per squeeze.
map.球囊过小：成人潮气量需 400-600 mL，婴儿型(240mL) 无法满足，请: Bag too small: an adult needs 400-600 mL tidal volume; the 240 mL infant bag is insufficient - switch to the 1500 mL adult bag.
map.球囊偏小：成人建议选成人型(1500mL)，儿童型(800mL) 单次挤压可能不: Bag slightly small: for an adult prefer the 1500 mL adult bag; the 800 mL child bag may not deliver enough per squeeze.

map.EC手法固定面罩，仰额抬颏开放气道，每次挤压约1秒，观察胸廓起伏确认有效通气。: EC-clamp the mask, head-tilt/chin-lift to open the airway, squeeze about 1 s each time, watch chest rise to confirm effective ventilation.
map.注意：避免过度通气！过度通气会导致胸内压升高、回心血量减少、心输出量下降。CPR: Note: avoid hyperventilation! It raises intrathoracic pressure, reduces venous return and lowers cardiac output. During CPR, compressions and ventilation must not run together.
map.成人心脏骤停 CPR 时，建立高级气道后按 10 次/分（每 6 秒 1 次）通: For adult cardiac-arrest CPR, ventilate 10/min (one every 6 s) after an advanced airway, avoiding hyperventilation.
map.婴幼儿呼吸骤停，按 20–30 次/分（每 2–3 秒 1 次）、小潮气量（仅胸: For infant respiratory arrest, ventilate 20-30/min (one every 2-3 s) with small tidal volume (chest just rising) and a gentle squeeze to prevent gastric distension.
map.有自主节律但通气不足者，按血氧与: For those with spontaneous rhythm but hypoventilation, adjust assisted
map.输入患者类别=成人、按压周期 30:2，工具给出通气 10 次/分（每 6 秒: Input patient=adult, cycle 30:2; the tool gives 10/min (one every 6 s) and 1/3 bag per squeeze, consistent with AHA guidance.
map.本工具能替代抢救时医师指令吗？: Can this tool replace the physician's rescue orders?
map.不能，仅作参数复核，实际通气以抢救团队指挥与胸廓起伏观察为准。: No; it only checks parameters. Actual ventilation follows the rescue team lead and chest-rise observation.
map.挤压后胃胀气明显怎么办？: What if gastric distension is obvious after squeezing?
map.降低潮气量至仅胸廓抬起，抬高下颌开放气道，必要时置口咽通气管。: Lower tidal volume to just chest rise, lift the jaw to open the airway, and place an oropharyngeal airway if needed.
map.有氧源时如何调整？: How to adjust with an oxygen source?
map.连接储氧袋可将 FiO2 提至近 100%，频率不变，仍应避免过度通气。: Connect a reservoir bag to raise FiO2 near 100%; rate unchanged, still avoid hyperventilation.
